name: 67215 · Wichita, KS
findings: ZIP 67215 (Wichita) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 3 of them (19%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 3 organizations.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
